record.question:
With reference to the “Digital India Literacy Mission 2026,” consider the following statements:
     1. The initiative is being driven under the nodal authority of the Ministry of Education to integrate
          financial literacy and cyber hygiene into secondary education.
     2. It mandates the creation of localized AI-driven chat-assistants via the “BHASHINI for Seva-
          Sanchalan” collaboration to assist rural citizens in accessing e-governance benefits without
          textual literacy barriers.
    Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
